title: Cubic character on a sign residue
statement: Let $s\in\mathbb Z^\times=\{-1,1\}$, and let $\chi$ be the character on $\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z$ that sends $1$ to $\zeta=\exp(2\pi\mathrm{i}/3)$. Then $$\chi(s\bmod 3)=-\frac12+\frac{\sqrt3}{2}s\,\mathrm{i}.$$
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a unit integer sign, hence $s\in\{-1,1\}$
